reviewer_findings.message: sys.path manipulation at module level is fragile. If the test runner is invoked from a different directory, _BACKEND_DIR may resolve incorrectly.
reviewer_findings.suggestion: Configure the backend path via conftest.py or pytest's pythonpath setting in pyproject.toml/pytest.ini instead of injecting into sys.path at import time.
